items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: when I joined the band... his real name was Alvin McBurney

ctx.x: Utah, I mean, yeah, from Utah, I meant. And, oh God, it was a funny band, we partied a lot. Alvino didn’t, but Alvino… like when I joined the band, here’s a typical, Alvino was really out there, but in a way I’ve never met before. I always thought of him as a little guy who played the Spanish guitar, you’d see these pictures and I wasn’t prepared for what I met when I met Alvino, he was a guy about six foot five and his real name was Alvin McBurney, from Fremont, Ohio. I always thought he was like a Spanish guy,…
